Rules: use only figures that appear in the data; no arithmetic beyond comparing two given values; no advice, no greetings, no headings. Write money in whole euros with thousands separators and the euro sign (English: €194,594 and −€194,594; Russian: 194 594 € and −194 594 €), rates with one decimal and a percent sign, months with one decimal. parameters.query:
select json_build_object(
     'meta',       (select row_to_json(m) from ceo_digest_demo.fn_meta() m)
    ,'byCategory', (select json_agg(t) from ceo_digest_demo.fn_cash_by_category($1::date, $2::date) t)
    ,'byWeek',     (select json_agg(t) from ceo_digest_demo.fn_cash_by_week($1::date, $2::date) t)
) as data

select json_build_object(
     'meta',       (select row_to_json(m) from ceo_digest_demo.fn_meta() m)
    ,'byPlan',     (select json_agg(t) from ceo_digest_demo.fn_customers_by_plan($1::date) t)
    ,'topBilled',  (select json_agg(t) from ceo_digest_demo.fn_top_customers('billed', 10) t)
    ,'topOverdue', (select json_agg(t) from ceo_digest_demo.fn_top_customers('overdue', 5) t)
) as data

select json_build_object(
     'meta', (select row_to_json(m) from ceo_digest_demo.fn_meta() m)
    ,'top',  (select json_agg(t order by t.rank) from ceo_digest_demo.fn_top_customers_period($1::date, $2::date, $3::text, $4::int) t)
) as data
